jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**About the Team**

The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers dedicated to delivering scalable, AI-powered software products that elevate how organizations work. We value clean architecture, intuitive user experiences, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer here plays a key role in shaping the quality and reliability of our products.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable software components with a strong emphasis on performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with product managers to translate requirements into well-architected solutions, owning features from design through delivery
* Build intuitive and extensible user experiences using modern UI frameworks, ensuring flexibility for customer-specific needs.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while enhancing existing product capabilities.
* Integrate automated testing into development workflows to ensure consistent quality across releases.
* Participate in design and code reviews ensuring best practices in performance, maintainability, and testability.
* Develop comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration and performance aspects
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by sharing best practices in engineering and quality
* Promote a culture of engineering craftsmanship, knowledge-sharing, and thoughtful quality practices across the team.

 **Qualifications**

Qualifications

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products.
* Proficiency in Python, Java, Javascript or other object-oriented languages.
* Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization
* Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Understanding software quality principles including reliability, observability, and production readiness.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack.
* Experience with AI-powered tools or workflows, including validation of datasets, model predictions, and inference consistency.
* Comfort with development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, profilers, source control, and Unix-based systems

Why Join Us

* Build and deliver high-impact software that powers digital experiences for millions of users.
* Collaborate in a culture that values craftsmanship, quality, and innovation.
* Work symbiotically with AI and automation tools that enhance engineering excellence and drive product reliability.
* Be part of a culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and shared success.

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

**Company Description**

CluCloud Innovations Pvt Ltd builds technology that advances financial inclusion by connecting lenders, businesses, and consumers in a mutually beneficial ecosystem. We help lenders reach underserved markets responsibly and enable businesses to offer seamless, embedded credit solutions.

Our focus is on fair and transparent access to financial products. By joining CluCloud, you’ll contribute to products with meaningful social impact and help improve access to finance for underserved communities. Our team values innovation, collaboration, and mission-driven problem-solving.

**Role Description**

As a Senior Frontend Developer, you’ll design, build, and maintain user-facing features for web applications that support financial inclusion. You’ll turn product requirements and UI/UX designs into high-quality, responsive, accessible interfaces, ensuring reliable performance across devices and browsers.

You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to shape technical solutions, refine user journeys, and integrate frontend components with APIs and backend services. * Foundational backend development knowledge, with experience integrating APIs, understanding data flows, and collaborating with backend teams.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Senior Business Analyst**

**Experience: 6-8 Years**

**Time Zone: CST**

**Employment Type:** **Full-time**

**Location: Nanakaramguda, Hyderabad**

**About Position:**

Adtech Corp is looking for a Business Analyst to support Data Democratization initiatives across enterprise systems and data platforms. In this role, the Business Analyst will partner closely with business domain stakeholders, Data Product Managers, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams to gather, analyze, and translate business needs into clear, actionable data and reporting requirements.

This position includes end‑to‑end requirements and analysis activities, including stakeholder interviews, evaluation of existing reports and data sources, documentation of functional and non‑functional requirements, and support of Agile delivery execution. The ideal candidate is experienced in working with enterprise data platforms, understands analytics and reporting concepts, and is comfortable bridging the gap between business users and technical delivery teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document data, reporting, and analytics requirements across multiple business domains.
* Analyze existing reports, dashboards, and datasets to identify gaps, redundancies, data quality issues, and opportunities for standardization or decommissioning.
* Translate business requirements into well‑defined user stories and acceptance criteria in Azure DevOps.
* Partner closely with Data Engineers and Data Analysts to ensure business requirements are correctly implemented in data pipelines, semantic models, and reporting layers.
* Support data validation and reconciliation activities by reviewing source‑to‑target mappings and business rules.
* Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring stakeholder validation and approval prior to production deployment.
* Document business definitions, KPIs, and data logic used in downstream reporting and analytics solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* As part of the Data Products team, help deliver accurate, complete, and timely data products that meet business needs.
* Support initiatives related to Data Democratization, including self‑service analytics enablement and data literacy efforts.
* Deliver on predefined individual and team goals with a focus on quality and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, experience working in enterprise data, reporting, analytics, or business analysis roles.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and data analysis skills.
* Ability to interact with many levels across the organization and to face and deal with issues in a mature and professional manner.
* Ability to prioritize, multi-task, and deliver to fast deadlines.
* Attention to detail and persistent approach to work and someone who is self-directed.
* Hands on writing SQL queries and able to review data within tables and assist data modelers with building data models that answer business questions.
* Experience in Data Analysis for Data & Reporting products.
* Strong hands-on data analysis skills using Python, SQL, Databricks, and Power BI.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and interpretive skills.
* Experience with Oracle, Salesforce data schemas; ability to map data flows from source systems to Databricks.
* Practical experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Ability to multi-task and work in a team environment, while following flexible schedule to meet deadlines.
* Able to present clearly and persuasively, listen and solicit clarification, and respond articulately to questions.
* Follows policies and procedures and supports the organization's goals and values.
* Can coordinate multiple parallel initiatives, communicate changes and progress, and complete deliverables on time and within budget.
* Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in mathematical, written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
* Working knowledge of Databricks/ Snowflake administration/architecture and capabilities.
* Ability to query and display large datasets while maximizing the performance of the workbook.
* Ability to interpret technical or dashboard structure and translate complex business requirements to technical specifications.
* Work with business stakeholders to create valuable reports and dashboards that provide insight, improve/automate processes, or add value to the team.
* High-level competency in Excel (VLOOKUP’s, pivot tables, etc.).
* Understanding of advanced calculations and statistical functions.
* A solid understanding of SQL, relational database management systems, data modeling, and normalization.
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail and accuracy.
* Prior experience in Data Engineering and/ or Data Science.
* Familiarity or experience with Atlan and/ or Sigma Computing tools is a plus.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Builder Developer II
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**The Builder-2 (Dev) Profile**

You are a full-stack agent engineer. You can take a complex business requirement and build the multi-step AI workflow that solves it, end to end, without someone breaking it down for you first.

**1. Core DNA**

* **AI-Native Workflow.** You use AI to accelerate development, testing and documentation as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place.
* **Agentic Implementation.** You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and long-running business logic.
* **Legacy-to-Modern Bridge.** You treat 20-year-old systems as puzzles for AI-driven modernization, not as someone else’s problem.
* **Evidence Over Confidence.** You don’t ship an agent because the demo went well. You ship it because you can show what it does on the edge cases — and you know your own error rate rather than claiming there isn’t one.

**2. What You Own**

**Your agent.** Design, build, debug, deploy, and keep running. Including the unglamorous parts: retries, state recovery, timeouts, what happens when the model is down.

**The evidence it works.** Before you refactor an undocumented module, you capture what it currently does — characterization tests, real inputs, real outputs. After, you show the behaviour matches. Your Builder 3 sets the standard; meeting it is your job, not theirs.

**Your blast radius.** You know exactly what your agent is permitted to touch, and you build so a wrong answer costs a review comment rather than a bad ledger entry.

**3. Your Elective Specialty (lean into one)**

* **The Agentic Architect (Systems)** — you don’t just build APIs, you build tool-calling interfaces and state management for agentic graphs that survive long-running business processes.
* **The UX/Interaction Builder (Product)** — the chatbox is just the beginning. You build generative UIs and browser-use agents that navigate existing portals to get work done.
* **The Data & Context Engineer (Data)** — master of the RAG pipeline. Vector stores, chunking strategy, and knowledge graphs that teach the AI how a Purchase Order relates to a GL entry.
* **The Reliability & Eval Engineer (QA)** — you move the team from prompt vibes to prompt engineering. DSPy for programmatic optimization, red-teaming agents to pressure-test financial logic.
* **The Infra & Agent-Ops Builder (DevOps)** — you build the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the thoughts of the AI.
* **The Domain Logic Translator (Business)** — you take 50 pages of accounting regulation and turn it into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* **Build execution agents.** Move beyond RAG into action — agents that navigate an ERP schema, find a data discrepancy and propose the fix.
* **Automate the untestable.** Wrap legacy business logic in modern tests and documentation using AI, starting with the modules everyone else has avoided.
* **Prove parity.** Capture what the old code does before you replace it, and show the new path matches — on the boring cases and the fiscal-calendar, multi-currency, partial-shipment ones.
* **Prompt engineering and evals.** Use frameworks like DSPy to move from vibes-based prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions.
* **Rapid prototyping.** Turn a “what if” into a working AI-driven feature in days, not months.
* **Fix your own agents in production.** Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again.

**What Good Looks Like**

*(Illustrative — real targets agreed with the hiring manager.)*

* **30 days:** Shipped your first agentic workflow into a real environment, however small.
* **90 days:** Owning a legacy module end to end — parity evidence, tests, deployment — with minimal supervision.
* **6 months:** Other Builders are reusing patterns you built. You’re the person people ask about one thing in particular.

**The Stack**

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, agentic coding tools, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Playwright, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent). And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.

**Who You Are**

* **You’ve shipped one.** You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work — not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did.
* **The early adopter.** You were using GPT-3 before it was cool and had a local model running the week it leaked. More time on r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub Trending and AI Twitter than on LinkedIn.
* **Agent-first thinker.** You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* **The manual-task hater.** You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you’ve already started drafting the automation.
* **Technically fearless.** A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn’t complexity, it’s a puzzle about to get solved. You aren’t intimidated by spaghetti code — you’re the one who brings the sauce.
* **Rigor over hype.** You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.

**Why Join Us**

* **The Final Boss of complexity.** ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. Automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain and you’ve mastered the hardest problem in software.
* **Agentic autonomy.** We don’t do tickets. We do missions. You’ll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win.
* **No red tape.** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a “Does It Work?” policy.
* **The Builder Tribe.** You won’t be the only AI person in the room. You’ll be part of a small squad of people equally obsessed with moving faster, where your a…

This role requires strategic and creative thinking, as well as a passion for building technical solutions that address customer needs.

We are a modern engineering organization that embodies industry best practices in Product-Led Growth (PLG). We are data-informed, hypothesis-driven, and rigorous in measuring outcomes to ensure undeniable customer and business impact. We collaborate closely with industry-leading PMs, designers, data scientists, user researchers, and marketers to build deep customer insights that inform the design of experiences used by hundreds of millions of people every day. We partner with teams across the company to deliver world-class services, and we create experiences that connect with customers across Microsoft products. We play a direct role in driving business growth and framing our business value to end users and our vibrant community of fans. We are looking for a **Principal Software Engineer** to join us.

Building a successful team involves creating an inclusive workplace where all people and ideas are welcome. We invest in the health of our team and take "how we work" as seriously as the impact we have on customers and the business. You don’t need to know everything when you join our team; just bring your growth mindset and willingness to learn, and we will provide mentorship and career growth to help you succeed.

The team's focus is on following 3 main areas:

* Client: Deliver high-performance native Android/iOS/Windows/macOS experiences using modern C++, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift and platform-specific frameworks, enabling contextual Product-Led Growth motions within Microsoft 365 apps.
* Full-Stack: Develop end-to-end features using React/TypeScript frontends paired with C#/.NET REST or GraphQL APIs and scalable data models—built to support millions of daily users.
* Backend: Design and scale Azure-hosted services in C#/.NET that handle hundreds of millions of requests daily, with opportunities to lead the adoption of event-driven architectures.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving the adoption and monetization of Microsoft 365 Copilot through Product-Led Growth. You will provide technical vision and hands-on leadership, solve complex problems, influence cross-functional teams, and drive architectural and organizational transformation across the stack.

You will also help shape how our team works in the age of AI by championing responsible AI-assisted engineering practices that improve developer productivity, accelerate learning and delivery, and strengthen quality. Aligned with Leadership vision, you will foster an AI-first engineering culture that enables the team to innovate, collaborate, and deliver greater customer and business impact.

You will build new experiences, lead experimentation, and use data to make informed decisions about release candidates. Global BL Quality & Lifecycle Manager

\_\_

As new industries turn to electrification, it is more vital than ever that we can support ABB’s customers with their new challenges and ensure that our Low Voltage System Drives products meet emerging requirements. That is why we are establishing a new role of Product Lifecycle Manager in our Quality & Lifecycle organization.

In this role, you will ensure that learnings from field performance and reliability testing reach all needed stakeholders for example in product management, R&D and sales. You will also analyze the effects of planned changes or new products on the existing technical offering and customer installed base.  The target is to fully leverage accumulated product performance data to support business growth.

This role is contributing to ABB’s  Low Voltage System Drives business line in Motion High Power division. You will work in close collaboration with stakeholders from division’s Product Management, Product Engineering, R&D and Service.  
  
This is a global role but location is set to be one of these: Finland (Helsinki), China (Beijing), Germany (Mannheim), USA (New Berlin, WI) or India (Bangalore). The work model for the role is: hybrid, #LI-Hybrid  
  
You will be mainly accountable for:

* Initial phase: Developing a new process, related documentation (reports, dashboards) and meeting practices to support efficient product lifecycle decision making and a learning organization
* Overseeing the process and ensuring execution of related tasks with stakeholders
* Coordinating and conducting  change impact analysis of additions, enhancements or simplifications of the existing product portfolio
* Facilitating continuous improvements along with the execution of lifecycle changes
* Managing global projects, involving stakeholders from various functions and local units

**Qualifications for the role**

* 10+ years of experience on product engineering, product management, portfolio management, R&D or similar area.
* 5+ years experience in leading people with or without line manager authority
* M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree in electrical /electronics engineering, mechanical engineering or equivalent
* Experience on process development is a benefit
* Experience on frequency converters is an asset
* You enjoy taking on new challenges and working with people across different functions, perspectives, and backgrounds to move ideas forward.
* Readiness for international travel, estimated 15% of work time

ABB High Power division is the market leader in high-power, high-performance drives, drive systems and packages for industrial process and large infrastructure applications, and a leading supplier of power conversion equipment for renewable energy and other applications. The division offers global support to help customers, partners and equipment manufacturers with asset reliability, performance improvement and energy efficiency in mission critical applications.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

The ideal candidate excels at bringing clarity to complex initiatives, proactively identifying risks and dependencies, supporting stakeholder alignment, and coordinating execution against agreed launch plans.

**Job Responsibilities**

**1. Product Launch Process Execution**

* Coordinate and support the execution of the product launch process across assigned products, features, and capabilities, identifying opportunities for improvement
* Coordinate launch planning activities, working with relevant stakeholders to define and track milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables
* Coordinate cross-functional launch readiness reviews, track agreed actions, and follow up with participating teams
* Support consistent and efficient execution of launch activities in line with agreed objectives, processes, and best practices
* Monitor launch progress, identify potential blockers, and work with relevant stakeholders to address or escalate issues that may impact launch success

  

**2. Operational Readiness & Excellence**

* Partner with Product Management, Delivery, Support, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, and Operations teams to identify and complete readiness requirements
* Support and coordinate the development and execution of readiness plans, including process updates, training, documentation, tooling, and support models
* Apply and maintain agreed readiness frameworks, standards, and best practices, and contribute suggestions for their improvement
* Maintain launch documentation and final deliverables repositories, supporting accurate audit records and history tracking
* Create and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, and stakeholder updates for assigned launch initiatives
* Identify risks, dependencies, process gaps, and operational challenges, and support the development and tracking of appropriate mitigation actions
* Support operational discipline by documenting and tracking actions, decisions, and commitments completion
* Use agreed measures to monitor launch effectiveness and readiness outcomes, and support post-launch performance reporting and lessons learned

  

**3. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Engagement**

* Build effective relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams to support alignment, transparency, and collaboration
* Act as a key coordination point for teams involved in assigned launch and readiness activities
* Support structured decision-making by providing relevant information, highlighting competing priorities and escalating conflicting requirements where appropriate
* Work effectively across teams without direct authority, fostering collaboration, and maintaining momentum against agreed actions
* Ensure stakeholders remain informed through clear, concise, proactive, and timely communications

  

**4. Process Optimization**

* Analyze existing launch and readiness activities and identify opportunities for improvement
* Use data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to recommend improvements to operational efficiency and scalability
* Contribute to the development and adoption of repeatable approaches and best practices that improve consistency across product launches

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and their application to operational processes is an advantage.

We welcome candidates who are collaborative, proactive, and highly organized, with the ability to build strong relationships and bring clarity to complex initiatives. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across diverse teams, coordinating multiple priorities, and translating business objectives into structured and actionable launch plans. They will help drive alignment, track progress, and support teams in delivering successful product launches and operational readiness outcomes.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
Arcesium seeks a Product Lead with deep private credit expertise to build and evolve our Private Credit capabilities. This is an individual contributor role, working closely with Engineering, Client & Partner Development, Sales, and Marketing. The product spans the deal-close and post-close lifecycle, including deal onboarding, portfolio monitoring, covenant and borrowing-base management, loan administration, reporting, and related workflows.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Execute the Private Credit product roadmap, translating product strategy, client needs, and domain knowledge into requirements and prioritized capabilities.
* Own product definition and design, working with Engineering and QA through development, testing, launch, and iteration.
* Work with clients and design partners to validate product direction and translate recurring needs into scalable capabilities.
* Develop business scenarios, test cases, and validation models to ensure the product handles real-world private credit structures and calculations correctly.
* Take new capabilities from prototype through production readiness and broader client adoption.
* Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Forward Deployed, and Marketing on positioning, demonstrations, client discussions, and go-to-market.
* Contribute to competitive analysis, business cases, and prioritization of R&D investments.
* Prototype workflows, calculations, and automation using AI-assisted coding and modern development tools.
* Define AI-enabled capabilities for interpreting credit agreements, compliance certificates, borrower reporting, trustee reports, and other private credit documents.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of hands-on private credit experience, with meaningful exposure to the lifecycle, documentation, calculations, and workflows of private credit investments; product management experience is an advantage.
* Strong depth in one or more areas of private credit, with direct lending experience particularly valuable; experience in asset-based finance, structured credit, or adjacent credit strategies is also relevant — spanning unitranche, senior or subordinated lending, delayed-draw facilities, revolvers, asset-based lending, specialty finance, CRE lending, ABS, CLOs, or loan portfolios.
* Working knowledge of covenant monitoring and testing, compliance certificates, breaches, waivers, and amendments; borrowing bases, advance rates, collateral eligibility, concentration limits, and reserves; and loan lifecycle events including drawdowns, paydowns, prepayments, PIK, OID, assignments, and participations.

* Ability to read credit agreements and related reporting and determine what a product needs to capture, calculate, validate, and monitor.
* Strong Excel and financial-modeling skills, including independent validation of covenants, borrowing bases, waterfalls, or similar calculations.
* Ability to work directly with data; SQL experience is strongly preferred, with familiarity in scripting, APIs, or low-code tools an advantage.
* Experience with platforms such as Wall Street Office, Allvue, Solvas, iLEVEL, or similar systems, preferred.
* Experience with generative AI tools for prototyping, or a demonstrated aptitude to use them effectively.
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, engineering, computer science, or a related field preferred; CFA, CA, MBA, FRM, or similar qualifications are an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain complex credit concepts clearly.

Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

jobs.description:
**About IDrive**

IDrive is a leading provider of secure and scalable cloud backup, S3-compatible object storage, and remote access solutions. Trusted by over 5 million users worldwide, we empower individuals and businesses to protect, access, and manage their data with high-performance tools built for speed, reliability, and security.

  

**About the Job**

As a **Technical Manager for IDrive BMR (Bare Metal Restore)**, you will lead the team in advancing our Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery platform, improving backup, recovery, and cloud integration while driving reliability, scalability, and performance across on-premises and cloud environments.

  

**What you will be doing:**

  

Technical oversight & execution

* Oversee the architecture and development of BMRs core platform (ZFS-based storage, backup orchestration, recovery automation).
* Define and execute the technical roadmap for next-gen BCDR capabilities, including AI-driven insights, smart retention, and hybrid cloud recovery.

* Oversee the complete product lifecycle from architecture and planning to QA, deployment, and maintenance.
* Drive collaboration across backend, frontend, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure efficient communication and delivery.

Core technologies youll work with

* Server OS: Debian 12
* Programming languages: Java, Python, C++, ReactJS
* Storage layer: ZFS
* Virtualization targets: Hyper-V, VMware
* Backup targets: Windows endpoints
* Architecture: Multi-service backend with a web-based management console

Process & collaboration

* Engineering & Delivery Management: Direct multi-disciplinary engineering teams (15+ engineers) delivering high-performance backup and restore software
* Agile Execution & Tooling: Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and team velocity using JIRA; foster an Agile/Scrum environment to ensure predictable, high-quality deliverables.

* Security & System Reliability: Embed application security best practices into the SDLC, focusing on secure data handling, encryption, and system hardening.

  

**What we expect from you:**

  

Experience & technical expertise

* 10 to 15 years of software development experience, including 46 years in technical or engineering management roles.
* Proven track record of leading multiple teams and technical leads, managing 20+ engineers.
* Strong proficiency in Java, Python, C++, and web-based architectures.

* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, testing automation, and DevOps practices.
* Ability to evaluate, adopt, and integrate emerging technologies into production systems.
* Passion for mentorship, technical leadership, and nurturing engineering talent.
* Knowledge of virtualization platforms (such as VMware and Hyper-V) and disaster recovery systems will be an added advantage.

  

**Why join us?**

  

At IDrive, we’re creating an environment where innovation thrives, talent is recognized, and people are empowered to grow. We are committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally.

  

Here’s what you can look forward to as part of our team:

  

Startup spirit

* Dynamic work culture where ideas are encouraged and innovation is celebrated
* Opportunity to take ownership of projects from concept to completion
* Hands-on exposure to new and emerging technologies
* Collaborative, fast-paced environment that rewards creativity and initiative
* Direct impact — see your work shape real products used by millions

Health & wellness

Culture & community

Perks that matter

Flexible work environment

**About the role**

You will own the technical design and build of complex Salesforce features, from requirement to production. You will write clean, secure and well-tested code, lead by example on standards, and guide junior developers.

You will work in agile teams alongside architects, business analysts, QA and client product owners, often presenting solutions directly to client stakeholders.

* Design and build integrations with core banking, credit bureau, payment and document systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events and Named Credentials.

* Mentor junior and mid-level developers and contribute to estimates, sprint planning and technical documentation.

* 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development on Salesforce Platform, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or Financial Services Cloud.
* Strong Apex: triggers, asynchronous Apex, design patterns, exception handling and test classes.
* Strong SOQL and SOSL, including query optimisation, selectivity and large data volume considerations.
* Lightning Web Components and JavaScript (ES6+), with working knowledge of Aura.
* Hands-on Experience Cloud (Communities) development: site setup, LWC on Experience Builder, sharing sets, guest user access.
* Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, OWD, sharing rules, Apex managed sharing, CRUD/FLS and with/without sharing.
* Record-triggered and screen Flows, and judgement on when to use Flow versus Apex.
* API integrations (REST, SOAP, Platform Events, Change Data Capture) and authentication (OAuth, Named Credentials).
* Salesforce DX, Git and at least one CI/CD tool such as Copado, Gearset or GitHub Actions.
* Good Communication Skills.

**What we offer**

* Work on live, business-critical Salesforce platforms for regulated banks and lenders.
* Direct client exposure and a clear path to Technical Lead and Architect roles.
* Sponsored structured learning through CK leadership training programmes.
* Competitive salary and group health insurance.
* A collaborative, engineering-led team in Kolkata.

We are looking for an experienced **Salesforce Business Analyst** with 5+ years of experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and Salesforce CRM implementations. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, Salesforce developers, administrators, and QA teams to translate business requirements into functional solutions that align with organizational objectives.

+ Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and automation using Salesforce.

+ Create and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process maps, and other project documentation.
+ Work closely with Salesforce developers, administrators, architects, and QA teams to ensure requirements are implemented correctly.
+ Configure and validate Salesforce standard features, including objects, fields, record types, page layouts, validation rules, flows, reports, and dashboards, as required.
+ Gather and document requirements for Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud implementations.

+ Manage and prioritize the product backlog in collaboration with product owners and business stakeholders.
+ Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
+ Support Salesforce integration requirements with third-party applications and external systems.
+ Develop test scenarios and test cases, support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and coordinate defect resolution.
+ Perform gap analysis between current business processes and proposed Salesforce solutions.
+ Support data migration, data validation, and data quality initiatives.
+ Assist with release planning, deployment coordination, change management, and post-production support.
+ Provide user training, prepare user guides, and support change adoption.
+ Ensure Salesforce solutions align with business objectives, security requirements, and organizational standards.
+ **Required Skills and Qualifications:**
+ Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
+ Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably with Salesforce CRM projects.
+ Strong hands-on experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management.
+ Good understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
+ Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, BRDs, FRDs, and functional specifications.
+ Knowledge of Salesforce objects, relationships, fields, record types, page layouts, profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules.
+ Understanding of Salesforce automation tools, including Flow Builder, validation rules, and approval processes.
+ Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
+ Experience in process mapping using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalent.
+ Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
+ Experience supporting UAT, functional testing, defect management, and release activities.
+ Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
+ **Preferred Qualifications:**
+ Salesforce Business Analyst certification.
+ Salesforce Administrator certification.
+ Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Salesforce CPQ.
+ Familiarity with Salesforce integrations, APIs, and data migration concepts.
+ Experience with reporting and dashboards, data analysis, and CRM analytics.
+ Understanding of Salesforce security, sharing models, and role hierarchy.
+ Experience working on large-scale Salesforce implementations or multi-cloud projects.
+ Familiarity with tools such as Postman, SQL, Data Loader, and test management platforms.

  

+ **Key Competencies**
+ Business process analysis and optimization.
+ Stakeholder engagement and expectation management.
+ Requirement prioritization and scope management.
+ Functional solution design and gap analysis.
+ Agile delivery and cross-functional collaboration.
+ Documentation, presentation, and decision-making.
+ Risk identification and issue resolution.

-----------------

The Advanced Software Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, and delivering high-performance, scalable industrial software solutions. This role blends deep technical expertise in C++, C#, and Intel Fortran with DCS/PLC/OTS domain expertise and strong collaboration across product, architecture, and customer-facing teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain industrial operator training simulator software using C++, C#, and Intel Fortran.

* 8+ years of experience in product/software development

* 8+ years of experience in Industrial Automation (DCS, PLC, OTS)

jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own DataMesh, one of Smartsheet’s most widely used cross-sheet data capabilities and a critical part of how enterprise customers build and run their solutions today. DataMesh sits at the centre of a multi-year shift in Smartsheet’s data model, as we evolve towards column links and, ultimately, relational data capabilities.
  
  
**You Will**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for DataMesh, balancing near-term stability and customer needs against the longer-term migration strategy
* Own the operational stability and serviceability of DataMesh, partnering with engineering and Support to prioritise defects, performance issues, and escalations
* Shape and execute the migration path from DataMesh to column links, working closely with the Data Links PM on feature parity, the advanced column links roadmap, and report-as-a-source as a critical dependency
* Lead customer and user discovery with enterprise personas (work admins, solution builders, system administrators, and power users) to understand how DataMesh is used in practice, identify migration blockers, and validate decisions before they ship
* Partner with Customer Success and GTM to plan communications, enablement, and migration support for enterprise accounts that depend on DataMesh
* Work with one or more engineering squads, navigating dependencies and making clear scoping and sequencing decisions across a complex, interconnected backlog
* Author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity
* Define success metrics for everything you ship, including DataMesh usage, migration progress, and quality indicators, and partner with data and analytics teams on instrumentation and reporting
* Represent DataMesh in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer conversations, including enterprise account engagements
* Perform other duties as assigned

**You Have**

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering features within enterprise SaaS or B2B software products
* Experience with data management, data modelling, workflow automation, platform integrations, or cross-sheet data referencing is a strong plus
* Experience managing a mature product through sustain, deprecation, or migration phases is a plus
* Strong customer instincts: you can run structured discovery, synthesise customer feedback, and turn it into well-scoped, validated product decisions
* A track record of writing product briefs, requirements docs, and specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, GTM, and Customer Success
* Comfort working with engineering teams across time zones, including stakeholders in North America
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption and quality metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting in leadership reviews and speaking directly with enterprise customers
* Familiarity with API-driven product development or working alongside platform engineering teams is a plus
* Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis
* Fluency in English is required

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

**About GeneralMind**

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of enterprise operations, AI systems, and platform product strategy.

You will work closely with customers, founders, and engineering teams to understand how large enterprises actually operate: ERP systems, supply chain workflows, approvals, exceptions, emails, spreadsheets, and fragmented operational processes.

This is not a traditional roadmap-management role. A core part of the job is identifying the reusable platform hidden underneath customer-specific operational problems. You will help determine what becomes a platform capability and what stays customer-specific, where configuration ends and engineering begins, where AI can reliably automate workflows, and where humans should remain in the loop.

**What You'll Do**

* Work directly with enterprise customers to deeply understand operational workflows and pain points.
* Translate customer realities into scalable product and platform decisions.
* Define roadmap priorities across platform, workflow, and AI capabilities.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture and product tradeoffs.
* Drive product thinking around AI agents, workflow orchestration, and enterprise operations.
* Identify recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable product abstractions.
* Help define the long-term platform strategy of the company.
* Improve how we capture, operationalise, and learn from customer feedback.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong product thinking and systems intuition.
* Deep understanding of enterprise operations, supply chain workflows, or ERP systems.
* Ability to operate effectively in highly technical environments.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs with long-term platform strategy.
* A strong ownership mentality and execution focus.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
* Fluency in English.
* Excitement about AI-native products and autonomous systems.

jobs.description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.

* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 4+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development

As a Product Owner, you are responsible for maximizing the value of the product and the work of the Delivery Team by clearly expressing Product Backlog items. You are responsible for ordering the items to best achieve goals and missions. This will show what the Delivery Team will work on next. You will ensure the Delivery Team understands items in the Product Backlog to the level needed.

* Review product features as they are developed, providing feedback and guidance.
* Participate as a member of the Agile Team, attend Scrum Events, and is responsible for defining epics and stories including Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
**Who are Evotix?**
===================

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**Role purpose**
----------------

The Director of Platform Engineering is the single accountable owner for the platform and data engineering capabilities used across every product domain in the business. The role consolidates Platform Engineering and Data Platform under one senior leader, and runs those capabilities as internal products with named service expectations, a published roadmap, and a regular review cadence with Domain Directors. This is a new role, created to separate architectural authority from operational delivery. The Chief Architect sets technical direction; this role owns the delivery, reliability, and adoption of the shared capabilities that direction depends on. The two roles are peers.

**Reporting and scope**
-----------------------

* **Direct reports:** Platform Engineering Manager, Data Platform Lead. Indirect organisation of approximately 15 engineers at steady state.
* **Internal customers:** Three product domains (360, Assure and Learn) plus internal engineering and operations teams.
* **Peer relationships:** Chief Architect, Domain Directors, Product Directors, Head of Business Technology

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Run shared capabilities as products.** Define service expectations, roadmaps, and adoption metrics for Platform Engineering and Data Platform. Be the single named owner for operational performance: incident response, SLOs, capacity, cost-to-serve, and roadmap delivery.

**Earn the trust of Domain Directors.** Treat domain teams as customers. Establish a regular review cadence with each Domain Director. Where a shared capability is not fit for a domain's needs, lead the work to fix it rather than defending the status quo.

**Partner with the Chief Architect.** Translate architectural direction (multi-tenancy, AI paved roads, Technology Radar) into deliverable platform capabilities on a documented timeline. Surface implementation realities that should inform the architectural roadmap.

**Manage cloud cost.** Own the FinOps practice for the platform estate. Drive unit cost down without compromising reliability and give domain teams the visibility they need to manage their own consumption.

**Build the team.** Coach, develop, and where needed recruit the sub-function leads. Build a team that can operate the function without the Director being the bottleneck for every decision.

**What success looks like at twelve months**
--------------------------------------------

* Platform Engineering and Data Platform operate under published service expectations, with a regular review cadence with each Domain Director.
* Incident response, SLO attainment, and cloud unit cost are tracked, reported, and trending in the right direction.
* Platform compliance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and IRAP is generated as a by-product of normal operations rather than as a separate audit project.
* The two sub-function leads are operating as a coherent leadership team with clear ownership of their domains.

**Essential experience**
------------------------

* Five or more years of engineering leadership, with at least three years owning a platform, infrastructure, or shared services function at director level or above.
* Demonstrated experience running engineering capabilities as internal products, including setting service expectations, managing roadmaps, and being accountable for adoption.
* Track record in a multi-product SaaS environment, with credible experience of the trade-offs between centralised platform investment and domain team autonomy.
* Direct accountability for AWS cloud infrastructure at scale, including FinOps practices and unit cost management.
* Experience as the engineering owner for at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent regulated compliance regime.
* Track record of building and developing engineering teams, including hiring at managerial level.

**Desirable experience**
------------------------

* Exposure to data platform engineering, including the operational realities of running analytics and data pipelines as a shared capability.
* Experience in EHS, GRC, or another regulated B2B SaaS domain.
* Experience leading a transition from federated to centralised shared services, including the change management involved.

**How you work**
----------------

* **Comfortable with productive friction.** Architecture and delivery are inherently in tension. You see that tension as where the work gets done, not as a problem to be eliminated.
* **Customer mindset toward internal teams.** You earn adoption by being genuinely useful, not by mandate. You would rather change a shared capability than win an argument about it.
* **Operationally credible.** You can be in the detail of an incident or a roadmap commitment when the situation requires it, without making yourself the bottleneck for normal operations.
* **Direct.** You give and receive feedback clearly, and you are willing to disagree with peers in the room rather than after the meeting.

* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.

**Job Purpose**

The Technology Service Desk is the front door to Digital & Tech for GSK colleagues worldwide and is delivered through an outsourced provider. This senior role owns the assurance and performance governance of the outsourced Tech Service Desk, managing the provider to agreed SLAs, XLAs and quality expectations and driving continuous improvement. A key part of the role is to drive the Service Desk modernisation agenda, increasing the use of AI and automation to accelerate shift left, expand effective self-service and deliver material improvements in colleague experience. It sets and refreshes SLAs and XLAs to ensure continuous stretch and improvement, and ensures a robust “voice of the customer” feedback-to-improvement cycle. Operating within GSK's largely outsourced, multi-sourced ecosystem, the role sets, monitors and governs standards and delivery discipline for the service outcome.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Desk Performance Assurance**

* Manage the outsourced Tech Service Desk provider to agreed SLAs, XLAs and quality expectations, holding the provider to account for outcomes.
* Assure the quality and delivery discipline of the service, driving improvements where performance or experience falls short.
* Own the end-to-end colleague experience of the Service Desk, not just the L1 interaction – where issues are escalated from L1 to L2, retain accountability for the outcome and ensure L2 delivers what is required to resolve it, escalating to L2 service owners where appropriate.

* Drive the refresh of SLAs, XLAs and measures to ensure continuous stretch and improvement over time.

* Experience running a structured voice-of-the-customer to improvement cycle.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical Business Analyst to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be a critical thinker with exceptional communication and problem solving skills, capable of translating complex business requirements into clear, actionable solutions. You will work closely with various stakeholders, including business leaders, technical teams, and end users, to drive successful project delivery and contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes and systems.

Key Responsibilities:

• Requirements Elicitation and Analysis:

◦ Conduct in-depth interviews, workshops, surveys, and other techniques to gather, analyze, and

validate business requirements from diverse stakeholders.

◦ Translate high-level business needs into detailed functional and non-functional requirements, user

stories, use cases, and process flows.

◦ Analyze existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for optimization.

◦ Perform cost-benefit analysis and feasibility studies for proposed solutions.

• Documentation and Modeling:

◦ Create comprehensive documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs),

Functional Specifications Documents (FSDs), process maps (e.g., BPMN), data flow diagrams, and

wireframes/prototypes.

◦ Maintain and manage requirements throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring traceability and

alignment with business objectives.

• Solution Design and Recommendation:

◦ Collaborate with technical teams (developers, architects, QAs) to design and propose effective and

scalable solutions that meet defined business requirements.

◦ Evaluate various solutions, considering technical feasibility, budget, timeline, and impact on existing

systems.

◦ Contribute to the development of business cases to justify proposed initiatives.

• Stakeholder Communication and Management:

◦ Act as a liaison between business units and technical teams, facilitating clear and consistent

communication.

◦ Manage stakeholder expectations and build strong, collaborative relationships.

◦ Present findings, recommendations, and project progress to various audiences, including senior

management.

• Testing and Implementation Support:

◦ Support the quality assurance (QA) and testing phases, including reviewing test plans, assisting with

user acceptance testing (UAT), and resolving issues.

◦ Monitor the implementation of solutions and ensure they align with business goals and deliver

expected value.

◦ Provide training and support to end-users as needed.

• Process Improvement and Data Analysis:

◦ Continuously identify opportunities for process improvement and suggest innovative solutions.

◦ Utilize data analysis techniques to derive actionable insights from various data sources.

◦ Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure project success and business

impact.

• 2-5 years of full-time experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role.

• Proven ability to gather, analyze, and document complex business requirements.

• Strong understanding of various business analysis methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

• Exceptional communication (written and verbal), presentation, and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in creating clear and concise documentation.

• Experience with project management principles and tools.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Confluence, Jira.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online.
